# dsh-zhipu-plan
Zhipu coding-plan sign-in, plan quota, and server-side usage for DeepSeek Harness, shipped as an out
-of-tree profile **bundle**. Nothing in the application is patched: the plugin installs into a profi
le, adds its own Settings page, and registers the coding-plan credential the shipped `zai` provider
own Settings page, and registers the coding-plan credential the shipped `zai` provider routes read.
## What it adds
- **Settings → 智谱套餐 (Zhipu plan)**, contributed by this package's browser half. The page is two view
s behind a glass tab bar — **联网能力** (what this plugin can do) and **套餐账户** (the account it does it f
or) — because they are separate subjects, and stacking them made one long page out of two. A view mo
unts the first time it is chosen and stays mounted while hidden, so a running read or a scrolled tab
le survives the trip to the other view; the bar follows the fluid-interface rules (the selection pil
l travels from where it already is rather than cross-fading, the press is answered on pointer-down,
and the view settles in from the value already on screen). The account view is laid out like ZCode's

own usage page:
- **剩余额度** — one card per bucket: the five-hour prompt pool, the weekly pool, and t
he monthly tool allowance. Each card shows how much is left, when that bucket refills, and a bar in
the bucket's colour; a bucket that is still untouched shows no reset entry, because a reset would gi

ve nothing back.
- **可重置额度** — a dialog listing each bucket's remaining share and the resets the dep

loyment has granted, with the countdown to their expiry.
[该节后续省略]
### How quota resets work
Resets are **granted by the deployment, not bought by a button**. Two things happen on their own:
- The reset status is re-read every five minutes, so a reset the deployment hands out appears by its

elf — the badge next to 剩余额度 counts them and counts down to the earliest expiry.
- When none is on h
and, the page repeats ZCode's eligibility request (`POST /api/v1/coding-plan/reset/opportunity`) on
the deployment's own terms: at most once every five minutes, and at the instant a refusal named. Tha
t request is what makes the deployment consider the account; it is never a control the user presses.
Spending one is the only manual step, and it goes through the dialog. The deployment confirms it — t
he window stays `processing` until the status reports the new `usedAt`, so a stale read cannot make
a spent reset look available again. This is the same mechanism ZCode uses (`packages/ui/src/lib/codi
ngPlanQuotaResetCoordinator.ts`, `packages/services/src/usage-stats/providers/bigmodelUsageQuotaProv
ider.ts` in that repository).
`pnpm run preview` writes the page with fixture data to `preview/plan-page.html` — signed in in both
languages, the reset dialog, the waiting and signed-out screens, a window being read, a read that f
ailed, and the all-time window — in both themes, so the layout can be reviewed without installing an
ything. `preview/plan-page-dark.html` is the same page against the dark theme; `scripts/preview-shot
s.mjs` photographs the scenes into `preview/shots/` when a browser is available.
## Install
### Plugin market (one click)
The plugin is listed in the dsh-market catalog. Open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search for **Zhip
u** (or 智谱), and press **Install** — the market installs the prebuilt release tarball below, so noth
ing is built locally. A profile without the market installs it first (`dsh plugin --profile <profile
> add dshmarket`, then restart the host).
### Prebuilt tarball
Every release carries the same version-free asset name, so this address always resolves to the newes
ase carries the same version-free asset name, so this address always resolves to the newest release:
<https://github.com/Ayelsh/dsh-zhipu-plan/releases/latest/download/dsh-zhipu-plan.tgz>
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The asset is the packed package: `lib/index.js`, `lib/typert.js`, `lib/client.js`, `cordis.patch.yml
`, `package.json`, `README.md`, and the preview page.
### From source
[代码示例省略，未执行]
A source install packs the repository exactly as it is. The build artifacts — `lib/index.js`, `lib/t
ypert.js`, `lib/client.js` — are committed, so the installed package carries them and no build scrip
t runs on your machine. Nothing in `src/` is compiled at install time; the market still prefers the
prebuilt tarball above because a source checkout is slower to download than the release asset.
The Host restarts the affected plugin graph; a full application restart is the reliable way to pick
up a newly installed bundle. Then open **Settings → 智谱套餐**, choose the deployment and plan kind, and
y installed bundle. Then open **Settings → 智谱套餐**, choose the deployment and plan kind, and sign in.
**Install from the tarball, not from this directory.** A local folder installed as a dependency beco
mes a `link:` to wherever it sits, and both Node and the harness resolve a linked package by its rea
l path. The harness routes bare `@deepseek-ai/*` requests to the running installation only for impor
ters under `$DSH_HOME/profiles`, so a linked folder anywhere else — `G:\dsh-build\dist\dsh-zhipu-pla
n`, a checkout, a desktop — cannot resolve `@deepseek-ai/cordis` and fails to load with `failed to i
mport`. A tarball is unpacked *into* the profile, which is why it works. Copying the folder into `$D
SH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/` also works, because then it is under the profiles tree, bu
t nothing manages that copy.
To remove it, uninstall the bundle the same way (`remove dsh-zhipu-plan`), which also drops its patc
e it, uninstall the bundle the same way (`remove dsh-zhipu-plan`), which also drops its patch layer.

The repository's Typert generator analyzes a `ts.Program` over the whole workspace, which an out-of-
tree package does not have. These two files are its output for this service, with the package name u
pdated; `pnpm run build` fails if they and `src/host/service.ts` ever disagree about which methods a
npm run build` fails if they and `src/host/service.ts` ever disagree about which methods are Remote.
